overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: its deliberations on a decided tax matter fall under the quasi-judicial exclusion, though it reminded the Board that adjudicatory proceedings themselves are subject to notice requirements.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to post notice of a meeting on December 12, 2023, when it issued findings of fact in a tax matter.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law when it convened relative to the McClellan Matter without posting notice.

allegations.summary: The Board argued that G.L. c. 30A, section 1 precludes Open Meeting Law application to any of its proceedings; the AG rejected that reading.
allegations.key_passage: We find no incongruity between the definition set out in section 1 and our prior finding that adjudicatory proceedings are governed by the Open Meeting Law.
